paper_title: Search for Spectral Irregularities due to Photon-Axionlike-Particle Oscillations with the Fermi Large Area Telescope
notes: Observed 95% CL excluded region for photon-ALP oscillations in the gamma-ray spectrum of NGC 1275 (Fermi-LAT, 6 yr Pass 8). Curve is the black solid 'Observed' contour from Fig. 2 left panel (fig2a.pdf), extracted from the vector path (get_drawings path 111). Plot axes: x = m_a in neV (converted to eV), y = g_agamma in units of 10^-11 GeV^-1 (converted to GeV^-1 via g_agamma = g11 x 1e-11). Axis calibration from tick strokes; x decade 165.4pt (10^0,10^1,10^2 neV at x=187.6,353.0,518.4), y decade 175.6pt (g11=0.1 at y=367.2, g11=1 at y=191.6). Cross-checked: contour lower edge min g11=0.47 (~5e-12 GeV^-1) matches abstract 'exclude couplings above 5e-12 GeV^-1 for 0.5<~m_a<~5 neV'. The excluded region is a CLOSED contour (a 2D blob), so points trace the loop and are NOT monotonic in mass: they start at the top-right (m=33 neV, g=7e-11), follow the descending right edge down and the lower boundary leftward, up the left edge, and back across the top frame (g11=7, the upper edge of the tested grid 0.1<=g11<=7). The top edge at g11=7e-11 is the plotted grid boundary, not a physical upper limit. There is a small interior 'hole' region (Fig.2, ~2.5-4 neV around g11~2, path 109) where P_gamma-gamma fluctuates and parameters cannot be excluded; not included here (outer boundary only). Not a haloscope: limit is independent of DM density. Red dashed curve is median expected (not reported).
